title: This Week's Schedule: Confirmations and Pre-Visit Summaries
description: Your week holds a full slate of visits, 54 percent of them telehealth. Reminders are out on every booked visit, and each confirmed patient gets a pre-visit risk summary — tier, top reasons, and open care gaps — so the short rural visit starts informed.

title: Rising-Risk Patients on Your Panel
description: 60 patients on the panel score in the high-risk tier across clinical, monitoring, social, and utilization signals. The platform flags and routes — each one carries the top reasons for the score so you decide what changes clinically.

title: Medication Adherence Gaps Ahead of Visits
description: 161 active medications show an adherence ratio under 80 percent. Where the patient has a visit booked this week, the gap is pulled into the pre-visit summary so the conversation can address it directly.
